Eligibility
Only Currently enrolled officially registered students are eligible to Participate. Registration will be confirmed only after the registration 
Form and Proof of payment have been submitted.
Participants 
Participants must carry a valid college ID card and may represent only one college.
Registration
1. Teams and individuals must register before the prescribed deadline. Any permitted change must be communicated to the organizers in advance.
2. Spot registration will not be allowed.

Code of Conduct
Participants must maintain discipline, fair play, and respect at all times. Misconduct cheating, abusive behaviour, 
or damage to property may result in disqualification.
4.
Payments
1.Registration fees must be paid only through the official QR code or registration form. No cash, UPI or additional payment 
should be made to any individual after successful registration.
5.
Sports Attire and Equipment
Participants must wear appropriate sports attire and footwear and use the equipment specified for the respective event. 
6.
Reporting Time
Participants must report at least 30 minutes before the scheduled event. Late arrival may result in disqualification.
7.
Officials Decisions
The decisions of referees, umpires, and event officials will be final. Any protest must be raised immediately and respectfully by 
the team captain or authorized representative.
8.
Substitutions:
Substitutions will be permitted only as specified in the rules of respective event. All substitutes must be registered before the match.
9.
Fitness and Medical Assistance 
Participants are responsible for ensuring that they are medically fit to compete. First-aid assistance will be available at the venue.
10.
Prohibited Substances
Alcohol, drugs, tobacco, and other prohibited substances are strictly forbidden on campus. Any violation will lead to disqualification
 and further action as applicable.
11.
Venue and Spectator Conduct
Participants and spectators must respect venue property, maintain cleanliness, and follow instructions issued by the organizers. Disruptive 
behaviour may result in removal and may affect the team concerned.
12.
Ceremony Attendance
Attendance at the opening and closing ceremonies is mandatory unless permission has been obtained from the organizers.
